title: fix: local TLS Gateway health checks fail with a managed proxy
body:
Closes #161929. Thanks @saizero-dr for the report and reproduction details.

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes local TLS Gateway health checks failing with `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'defaultProtocol')` when a managed HTTP proxy is enabled.

## User Impact

Doctor and shared Gateway restart/readiness checks can reach the local TLS Gateway without disabling the configured proxy. Default loopback traffic stays direct; explicit `proxy` and `block` loopback modes remain enforced. No dependency, updater, or configuration-schema changes.

## Why This Change Was Made

Node handles `agent: false` by constructing the global agent's class without arguments. Proxyline's global agent requires options. The probe now selects an explicit agent through the existing proxy-routing helpers and applies the existing Gateway loopback policy check. Direct TLS probes disable socket and session reuse so certificate rotation remains subject to the fingerprint check.

## Evidence

- Linux Docker, Node **v24.21.0**, real TLS Gateway and a request-logging HTTP CONNECT proxy; all CLI processes used isolated explicit profiles and synthetic state.
- Published **2026.9.7** and pinned source baseline **5730ff318d7**: Doctor printed the exact `defaultProtocol` health-check failure. The source CLI used a separate state directory from the Gateway to avoid the unrelated migration ownership lock.
- Built candidate: `status --deep` and `doctor --non-interactive` both exited **0**, with no health-check failure in default mode. Proxy logs contained outbound CONNECTs to `registry.npmjs.org` and `clawhub.ai`, and **no** loopback Gateway CONNECTs.
- `loopbackMode: proxy`: both commands exited **0**, with Gateway CONNECTs in the proxy log. `block`: status exited **1**, and Doctor reported the existing explicit loopback-policy refusal; no loopback CONNECT was sent.
- Regression test failed before with the exact constructor error and passed after. Focused local-probe and restart-health suites: **27 tests passed**. The changed regression took **48 ms**; the two-file run took **34.53 s** including cold worker compilation. Certificate mismatch, rotation, and cancellation coverage also passed.
- `git diff --check` passed.
- Published **2026.9.7 (c074824)** updater in an isolated global npm prefix upgraded to the canonically packed candidate with the managed proxy enabled: **exit 0, status ok**. Candidate Doctor, lint, config, plugins, recovery, Gateway startup, package swap, post-update verification, and post-plugin Doctor lint completed successfully. Recovery reported **`serviceRestartSafe: true`**. The packed artifact passed the repository's package-integrity check.

Limits: status succeeded on the baseline too, so this does not claim to reproduce its reported exit-1 variant. The updater deliberately skipped OS-service reconciliation for the explicit non-default state/config paths; the proof does not claim a systemd restart. Doctor's ordinary exit code is not a health verdict: the baseline returned 0 while printing the health failure.

### CI

The exact-head CI run was cancelled by fail-fast after `setup-inference.first-signin.integration.test.ts` timed out at 90 seconds in [checks-node-changed-compact-large-27](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36737078545/job/109962014108). The [same test and timeout also failed on an independent PR](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36736030552/job/109958528062). There were 21 cancelled jobs. `check-test-types-core-4` logged all six type graphs passing before its job was cancelled; it did not report a type error.
